blurb: Guests rent luxury yachts docked at One15 Marina in Brooklyn Bridge Park. They can operate the boat themselves if licensed or hire a captain. Food and drinks are allowed with restrictions; the crew provides safety and service during the trip.
extraNote: Full refund if cancelled 10 or more days before trip; no refund if less than 10 days · Captain or NYC By Water may cancel for safety or weather; renter cannot cancel for bad weather without approval · No refund for no-shows within one hour of check-in · Captain and crew expenses paid separately directly to crew before trip · Strict departure time; no extension for late arrival · Cleaning fee $250-$500 if boat left messy · Marina gate at One15 Marina in Brooklyn Bridge Park, Brooklyn
